load ECX from [0x016b3c0c] and call GameInput::OnKeyDown
compute special path when modifiers has both bits 0x2 and 0x4

ordinary path calls 0x00e7f630 first, then 0x00e81120 on AL not equal to one
return true only when the selected action returns exactly AL=1; otherwise return false

state_contract.callback_order: route, optional UI toggle, GameInput bit update and refresh, UI gate, then action fallback order
